parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of plastic, typically circular and flat for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head is the upper nozzle and connector part of the dispenser, made of plastic, attached to the pressing lid.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal pump to the outside through the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the pressing lid, with internal fluid flow during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or opaque plastic, cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (soap, lotion, sanitizer, etc.) to be dispensed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid.
